budgetExceptions.panel/WorkspaceService.ts: the workspace aggregate: languages, LSP, buffers and the registry mirror in one object. Splitting it is a design change, not a move
budgetExceptions.panel: the app shell is 27 files by nature (one page per UI plus its server side, plus handlers/); the budget counts files, and this slice is the one that renders

purity.debugtool/protocol.ts: the wire format itself: a collector in another process, or another language, has to implement it from this file alone
purity.debugtool/serializer.ts: turns live objects into wire nodes; pure so a test can check the output without a debuggee
purity.debugtool/sampler.ts: fold-stacks and stall detection: arithmetic over samples, checkable without a process
purity.debugtool/diff.ts: snapshot diffing over wire nodes; same reason
purity.debugtool/ui.ts: renders the page as a string; whatever serves it owns the transport
